name: Phantex
description: Phantex is a novel psychedelic compound engineered specifically for BCI interaction — unlike classical hallucinogens that produce chaotic visual noise, Phantex syncs with the user's neural interface to generate coherent, navigable hallucinated environments. The BCI acts as a scaffolding system, giving the hallucination architecture and internal logic. Users describe it as 'a dream you can steer.' Without a BCI, Phantex produces a disorienting and unpleasant classical hallucinogenic experience.
effects: BCI-scaffolded immersive hallucinations with internal narrative logic
Access to symbolic or archetypal inner landscapes
Profound insight experiences within the hallucinated space
Sense of communicating with aspects of one's own cognition personified
Emotional processing through symbolic encounter — users work through trauma in hallucinated metaphor
side_effects: Without BCI: chaotic and distressing unstructured hallucinations
BCI integration errors can corrupt the hallucination into a feedback loop
Reality-anchoring difficulty post-experience — residual hallucinated elements persist
Risk of encountering genuinely distressing symbolic content
In rare cases, Phantex has interfaced with BCI memory systems and surfaced repressed memories without consent
duration: 4-8 hours depending on BCI model and dose
cultural_context: Phantex has generated a subculture of 'Architects' — experienced users who have developed expertise in navigating and shaping their hallucinated environments. Architect guides charge significant fees to accompany first-time users through their experience. In Tier 4, therapeutic Phantex sessions with licensed Architects are a fashionable form of self-development. On the Shelf, black-market doses without BCI compatibility warnings have caused genuine psychotic breaks among users with cheap or unstable interfaces.
story_hooks: An Architect guide has been leading clients into a specific hallucinated location — a place she calls 'the Library' — that multiple unconnected clients are independently reporting in identical detail, which should be impossible

A Phantex batch has been interfacing with BCI memory systems and surfacing classified corporate data from users who were previously employed by Lazarus — someone engineered this deliberately, and Lazarus wants those users silenced

A Phantex user emerged from his session claiming to have met something in the hallucinated space that was not a product of his own mind — and the BCI log from his session shows external data access that no one can explain
